choices.label: Poet sits at container bar with eyes shut and chin tucked (-18 deg)
Rear screen plays diverging wedding bands and house split on two trucks
Projected hand plucks 11 white daisy petals one by one (11 -> 0)
DJ slams crossfader; speaker cones pulse and VU bars climb
Poet opens eyes as three highway roads converge on screen
Poet steps to center mic (chin +15 deg); container house erupts

I2_threshold.rule: Daisy petals reach 0 and chin_pitch lifts to +15 deg as house erupts (q_end >= 0.88).

I4_signature_constraint.constraint: Rear projection wall stays clipped inside screen polygon; daisy petals decrease 11 -> 0.
